plot: Max is in charge of little Luna at the park, chases a butterfly and suddenly cannot find her; his loud running search only makes him dizzy, Dog's nose follows a straight kitten trail to the gate, and there Luna is waiting at Grandma's orange meeting cone, because Max was the one who got lost; Luna has to go home tomorrow at sunset, and Max needs a goodbye gift.

beats.say: Luna? LUNA! Where are you? She was right here!
Max is in charge of little Luna today. And Luna is gone.
Where is Luna? Grandma trusted me! Only me!
Let's go back a little. Ten minutes ago, at the park gate.
Listen, you two. Do you see that big orange cone?
If anyone gets lost, go to the cone and wait. Promise?
I promise! Orange cone! Wait there! I'm very good at waiting.
Nobody will get lost, Grandma. I'm in charge today!
Grandma sits down on a bench with her book.
Little Luna holds on to Max's tail. Tight, tight, tight.
Stay close, Luna. The park is big. Very, very big.
I'll stay so close. Like a sticker on your tail!
Ooh! A yellow butterfly! Come back! I just want to say hi!
Max chases the butterfly. Past the trees. Past the pond. Zig, zag.
And when he finally turns around... no Luna. No cone. No Grandma.
Okay. Don't panic. A big cousin never panics. Ahhh! I'm panicking!
Max! Hi! I found my blue ball under a bush! Look!
Dog! Not now! I lost Luna!
She's so small, and the park is so big. So big!
Lost? Little Luna? Oh no, oh no, oh no!
If Grandma finds out, she'll never put me in charge again.
I'll find her myself. The fastest way. Loud and fast!
Max runs left. Luna! Max runs right. Luna! Up the hill. LUNA!
Around and around he goes, faster and faster. Then... bump. Dizzy.
The trees are spinning. Why are there two Dogs?
There's only one of me, Max. I checked twice.
Sit down for a second. Breathe in. Breathe out. Good cat.
Shouting didn't work. Running didn't work. What do I do now?
When I lose my ball, I don't run. I sniff! Sniff, sniff!
Your nose? Dog, you're a genius! Okay, sniff for Luna!
Dog puts his nose down. Sniff, sniff, sniff. Very slowly.
I smell... Max. And more Max. Max everywhere.
Max went this way, then that way, then around the tree twice.
That's just my butterfly trail! I zigged and zagged everywhere!
Wait. Here's a tiny smell. Soft and milky. That's a kitten smell!
The kitten smell doesn't zig. It doesn't zag. It goes straight.
It goes straight back. Straight to the park gate!
The gate? Grandma is at the gate! Oh no, she'll know!
We have to find Luna before Grandma sees she's missing!
Max and Dog run along the straight little path. Faster, faster!
And there, by the big orange cone, sits a tiny white kitten.
Max! There you are! You got lost!
Me? Lost? I wasn't lost. I was looking for you!
You ran after the butterfly. Then I couldn't see you anymore.
So I did what Grandma said. Go to the orange cone.
And wait, and wait. I counted all the ducks. Eleven ducks!
So you weren't lost at all. I was the lost one!
And you found your way back. That's what matters, Max.
Grandma was by the cone the whole time, keeping Luna company.
Grandma! I'm sorry. I'm the worst in-charge cat ever.
Everyone gets lost sometimes, dear. Even grandmas. Even big cousins.
The smart part is having a plan. And Luna followed it.
I'm the in-charge cat now! Everybody hold my tail!
And my nose found you! Can my nose get a treat?
Your nose gets the biggest treat in the park, Dog.
Then something lands softly on Max's nose. A yellow butterfly.
You again? No, no. I'm not chasing you this time!
Everyone laughs. Even the butterfly does a little dance.
If you get lost, don't run around in circles.
Go to the meeting place. Stay there. And wait for your family.
Just like me! The orange cone cat!
They walk home slowly. Luna holds Max's tail all the way.
Luna's mom comes for her tomorrow, at sunset.
Tomorrow? But I don't want to go yet.
Then I need a goodbye gift by sunset. But what?
